// Negative control (#5170): every path out of the verb declares its exit — through a same-file helper
// closure, through `error(...)`, through a throw, in a try and in its catch, and in a switch.
import { output, error } from './io.cjs';
import { declareGateExit } from './gate-exit.cjs';
import { gateVerdict, gateUnreadable } from './gate-verdict.cjs';

function emitVerbVerdict(verdict: ReturnType<typeof gateVerdict>, raw: boolean): void {
  output(verdict.payload, raw);
  declareGateExit(verdict, 'status');
}

export function cmdFixtureVerb(file: string, mode: string, raw: boolean): void {
  if (!file) {
    error('file required');
    return;
  }
  if (file === 'boom') throw new Error('boom');
  switch (mode) {
    case 'a':
      emitVerbVerdict(gateVerdict('pass', false, { valid: true }), raw);
      return;
    default:
      break;
  }
  try {
    emitVerbVerdict(gateVerdict('block', true, { valid: false }), raw);
  } catch (err) {
    emitVerbVerdict(gateUnreadable(false, { error: String(err) }), raw);
  }
}
